Help me draft the plot of this story.

A girl in a secondary city in south america always liked superheroes, male and
female. In the first episode we can have a guy from another class that shares
the superhero stuff — but she is aware others can criticize her: "they are now
boyfriends", "he is too ugly for you", "dont get weird, stop meeting him".

The strongest part already exists: the story is not asking "how to become Batman
in Latam?" but "what does heroism even mean when institutions are collapsing?".
That changes everything. Small city at sunset. Motorcycles. Rain. Cheap superhero
shirts. The smell of frying oil and fear.

The core conflict could become: how does someone remain good in a place that
punishes goodness? She tries multiple versions of heroism across the series, and
each one partially fails — not because heroism is fake, because real heroism is
incomplete.
